label: Cover
notes: One line: Marshal is the commanding operational authority of the PyForge Dream-to-Code factory — the BMAD-method orchestrator that turns a solidified Dream into validated code without vibe coding. This deck introduces the Commander.

label: Act I — The Commander
notes: Act I: who Marshal is. While Atlas charts the map, Warden secures the perimeter, and Mason binds the packages, Marshal runs the heavy automated machinery of the factory floor.

label: Anti-vibe pragmatism
notes: The core mindset: Marshal operates entirely on strict structural inputs. Good intentions and close-enough do not exist. A sub-agent that deviates from the spec is flagged instantly and forced into a corrective iteration.

label: Ruthless context containment
notes: Mindset two: context discipline. Each sub-agent receives only the exact context its task requires. Containment kills hallucination and keeps the line fast.

label: Act II — The bmad-suite
notes: Act II: the toolkit. Marshal orchestrates the full BMAD stack — official modules, web bundles for flat-rate planning, community plugins, and the autonomy layer.

label: One method, five modules
notes: The official BMAD modules Marshal drives: BMM core with 34+ workflows, BMB for building custom agents, TEA for risk-based testing, BMGD for game dev, CIS for creative intelligence. Plus web bundles (Gemini Gems, Custom GPTs) for flat-rate planning, and community plugins like skill-forge.

label: Act III — Running the line
notes: Act III: the factory loop itself — how a spec becomes validated code, and how the whole run stays visible.

label: The factory loop
notes: Three responsibilities, one loop. Spec marshalling: the Dream solidified into targeted instruction blocks. Agent mobilization: tactical sub-agents spawned per role. Defect containment: failed test output piped back as explicit self-healing instructions. The CLI cadence shows the shape of a run.

label: Every run stays visible
notes: Visibility: as bmad-loop drives epics and stories, the program dashboard is kept current and published on GitHub Pages — deliveries, notables, roadmaps and updates are marshalled from the same run state. Nothing invisible ships.

label: Validated code, not vibes
notes: Close on the creed: the Dream deserves better than vibes. Marshal exists so that what ships is what was specified — enforced, contained, validated. Hand off to Atlas, Warden and Mason.
